messages:
marie: seeing a burst of 502/403s from proxies that re-encode operator creds into project tokens during cross-region calls. :grimacing:
aj: can you share a tiny repro? sounds like claim scoping is getting lost.
sam: yep, operator-bridge rewrite change is likely culprit.
marie: repro steps:
1) client: Authorization: Bearer op_ABC123
2) proxy rewrites to: Authorization: Bearer proj:XYZ:op_ABC123 + X-Actor: op_ABC123
3) backend: rejects with 'unknown subject or scope'
leo: that mutation is risky. some services key off raw token id so they see a new principal.
aj: also perf issue: proxy calls token-service per request to mint proj tokens, no cache 60s, token-service hits 429.
sam: two problems: authz semantics and minting scale.
marie: short-term: revert rewrite -> passthrough, gate rewrite behind feature flag, add tiny in-process LRU cache for minted tokens.
aj: i'll PR the revert and cache (TTL ~30s).
sam: for compatibility, suggest attestation header (X-Proxy-Attestation) instead of token mutation; services can opt-in to verify. safer rollout.
leo: agreed. require signed attestation, nonce, short ttl, and key rotation.
marie: long-term: document explicit contract: either mint audited project tokens or always passthrough and provide signed attestations. no silent partial translations.
ops-bot: created incident channel #inc-token-fanout-1719230000
sec-bot: reminder: any minting flow needs threat model + sign-off.
marie: action items: marie revert behind flag; aj add cache + metrics; sam draft attestation RFC + libs; leo add audit metrics on token service.
aj: will toggle in staging then canary.
sam: RFC will include example verification snippets for go/python.
marie: thanks all, ping me if you see more errors. :eyes:
